inputs.text: Listen to this: It's being introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda. The proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so that they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for... But this is clearly no accident or simple safety measure. The elites and institutions are coordinating through state agendas like this to slowly disarm the public, using the machine gun excuse as cover while they invert the narrative to make legal ownership harder and more restricted. It's all about hidden control, and their denials just prove the real motives are being concealed.
